name: Shinar

entries: Shinar, watch of him that sleeps

identification.note: The broader Mesopotamian plain containing Babylon; Genesis uses the name for both the region and, in Genesis 11, the specific site of the tower of Babel.

description: The plain where humanity built the tower of Babel before God confused their language and scattered them (Genesis 11:1-9), and, later, where the invading king Amraphel of Shinar came from in Abraham's day (Genesis 14:1).
